description:

Join me, Chris, as I brainstorm with a listener on how to turn a genius idea into an Amazon bestseller. I deep dive into the story of a young college student growing his tutoring business through Facebook groups and wrap up with some super hot takes on starting an AI business... you wont want to miss them and I want to know your thoughts!
